label: IMM SIE -> EAP API
info:
# IMM SIE EDA -> EAP IMM PMS (PUSH)

## Configure
1. Inject **1 Set EAP webhook URL** (includes throttle)
2. Inject **2 Set machine fleet map** (Machine Configuration ID + name)
3. Deploy

## Throttle (stops continuous POST spam)
Default: max **1 push / 10 seconds / machine**, and skip unchanged payloads.

```json
{
  "webhook_url": "http://192.168.1.116/api/imm/nodered/webhook/push",
  "webhook_secret": "",
  "push_min_interval_ms": 10000,
  "push_on_change_only": true
}
```

Do NOT use :5174 for webhook (frontend only).
